name: Trapventure
detailed_description:
Trapventure is a tough but fun medieval adventure where you’ll be solving tricky puzzles, dodging deadly traps, and battling skeletons. Play as an archer and test your reflexes and brainpower as you jump across floating platforms, face off against enemies, and work your way through dangerous environments. It's a challenge, but that’s all part of the fun!

Key Features:

  • Traps & Puzzles: Solve puzzles and avoid traps that’ll test your timing and smarts.

  • Platforming Fun: Jump, dodge, and time your movements.

  • Rage-Inducing Challenge: It's designed to make you sweat. Expect to fail, expect to try again, and expect to love the thrill of overcoming tough obstacles.

A Note from the Developer

Trapventure is my first fully completed game, developed solo while I was learning game development. Starting from a background in Level and Game Design, I pushed myself to learn more about programming and game creation through tutorials and personal effort.

This game is the result of that journey, a small but intense adventure filled with challenges. I hope you enjoy the experience as much as I enjoyed making it.

Thank you for playing!

short_description: A tough, rage-inducing platformer where you solve puzzles, dodge traps, and navigate through deadly obstacles to escape a cursed fortress. Good for players who love a challenge and don’t mind a little frustration along the way.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or newer, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-2550K, 3.4 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 | Radeon R9 290X or Radeon RX 480
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:

  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
